fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The ANC's text, headed 'Statement by the President of the African National Congress, Cde Jacob Zuma, to the closing of the 52nd National Congress of the ANC' (sic, for Conference) and dated Polokwane, 20 December 2007, has him say he stands before the delegates 'as the 12th President of the ANC'.

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: Near its end the statement says 'the incoming NEC and I accept the mandate you have given us'.

locator.section: paragraph beginning 'Comrades and friends, the incoming NEC and I accept the mandate'

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: Zuma says he is called upon to lead the organisation 'succeeding Cde Thabo Mbeki', and later refers to 'Cde Mbeki, former President of the ANC'.

locator.section: paragraph beginning 'Comrades, I am called upon to lead'; paragraph on the political and organisational reports

rows.role_title: President of the African National Congress
rows.text: The statement acknowledges likely anxiety about there being two Presidents, one of the state and one of the party, and says he and Mbeki would develop smooth working relations between government and the ruling party.

bounded_scope: ANC President observations for CLAUDE-C01-16 only (role za_anc_president on the AFRICAN NATIONAL CONGRESS observation). Conference election, publication of results, acceptance, handover speeches, departure statements, deputy and chair offices and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Presidency of the Republic (za_presidency) is excluded and no row feeds it.
